subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Tony's Wabeno Redi-Mix, LLC, federal land management agencies, and industry stakeholders involved in stone, sand, and gravel development.
dimensions.evidence: convey to Tony's Wabeno Redi-Mix, LLC all right, title, and interest... in and to the property

dimensions.assessment: Transfers approximately 14 acres of federal land including mineral rights and mandates a federal study and report on permitting processes.
dimensions.evidence: convey approximately 14 acres of federal land, including the mineral rights... to Tony's Wabeno Redi-Mix, LLC

dimensions.assessment: Requires the private entity to pay market value for the land and cover all associated survey, appraisal, and environmental analysis costs.
dimensions.evidence: pay to the Secretary an amount equal to the market value of the land... and all costs associated with the conveyance

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a specific federal land sale and requires an executive branch comprehensive review and report on mineral permitting processes.
dimensions.evidence: conduct a comprehensive review of the Federal permitting processes for the development of stone, sand, and gravel on Federal lands

dimensions.assessment: Combines a one-time property conveyance with a one-time administrative report and review.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act... submit to... Congress... a report

missing_information: Exact dollar amount of the land's market value and conveyance costs
importance_detail.rationale: Directs a specific federal land conveyance in Wisconsin to a private entity at market value and requires a comprehensive review of federal permitting processes for stone, sand, and gravel.
